\section{Mutation Primitive Catalogue}\label{app:primitives}
Table~\ref{tab:prims} lists the catalogue by class and family. Every primitive
carries an identifier, a description, a source and a transform over the raw
request model (method, target, header list, body); depth-1 cases apply each
primitive to every compatible base operation. The route-space slice adds two
fragment primitives (\texttt{x-frag-*}) targeting the nested routes.
